ASPIRE.notes: ASPIRE (MTN-020) is one of the 2 dapivirine ring RCTs pooled in this analysis ('2 RCTs, 4,564 women'). Abstract states participants were 'mainly from sub-Saharan Africa' but does not name ASPIRE explicitly or link it to specific countries. No PMC full text available; extraction is abstract-only (confidence_layer_m: medium). Layer (b) requires a characteristics table with African country names — not accessible from abstract. Layer (c) requires trial name + African country in same/adjacent sentence — abstract provides regional description but does not co-locate trial name and country. All booleans FALSE pending full-text verification.

RING_STUDY.notes: RING_STUDY (IPM-027) is the second of 2 dapivirine ring RCTs pooled in this analysis. Same rationale as ASPIRE: abstract confirms sub-Saharan African setting but does not name RING_STUDY explicitly or link it to specific countries. No PMC full text available; extraction is abstract-only (confidence_layer_m: medium). All booleans FALSE pending full-text verification.
